saveFailed.where: Error toast on any screen when a change fails to save (notes, preferences, notifications)
saveFailed.context: {action} is the thing that failed to save, e.g. "track details" or "metronome speed" (a noun phrase supplied by the screen; today often English)

syncErrorTitle.where: Sticky error toast title when the browser's offline cache breaks

syncErrorBody.where: Sticky error toast body under "Sync error"

syncPausedTitle.where: Sticky error toast title when the live database connection shuts down

syncPausedBody.where: Sticky error toast body under "Sync paused"; Firestore is the database product name

reload.where: Button inside the sync error toasts that reloads the page
